verdict.rationale: E2B's own docs say sandboxes have outbound internet access by default, which can be restricted with an on/off switch or with fine-grained allow and deny lists (e2b-docs-10). The Vercel AI SDK guide separately mentions outbound network controls (e2b-docs-44), so the core of the explicit egress-policy story is documented. missing for 10: in-depth docs on policy syntax and granularity (domains, IPs, ports), whether policies can be set per template or org-wide, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
